pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of The New Testament Books? (1 mark)
   A. Say The New Testament Books has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of The New Testament Books with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use The New Testament Books to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The New Testament Books.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Loyalty to God? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Loyalty to God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Loyalty to God has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Loyalty to God.
   D. Use Loyalty to God to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

4. Which response best shows understanding of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top.

5. Which response best shows understanding of The Exodus? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Exodus to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Exodus with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say The Exodus has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Exodus.

6. Which response best shows understanding of The Holy Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say The Holy Bible has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Holy Bible.
   D. Use The Holy Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Redemption after the Fall of Man? (1 mark)
   A. Use Redemption after the Fall of Man to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Redemption after the Fall of Man with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Redemption after the Fall of Man.
   D. Say Redemption after the Fall of Man has no place in daily life.

8. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

9. Which response best shows understanding of The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean ? (1 mark)
   A. Use The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean  to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean  has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean .

10. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

11. Which response best shows understanding of Teachings of Prophet Amos? (1 mark)
   A. Use Teachings of Prophet Amos to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Teachings of Prophet Amos with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Teachings of Prophet Amos.
   D. Say Teachings of Prophet Amos has no place in daily life.

12. Which response best shows understanding of The Old Testament Prophets? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Old Testament Prophets has no place in daily life.
   B. Use The Old Testament Prophets to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Old Testament Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Old Testament Prophets.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain The Holy Bible and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Redemption after the Fall of Man and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Stewardship Over Creation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Redemption after the Fall of Man; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
